observed: QueueUpload, PlaceInQueueRequest, FolderContentsRequest, and legacy TransferRequest preserve a 256 KiB component path.
Modern QueueUpload reaches share lookup and is queued under the oversized virtual path.
Legacy direction=download TransferRequest reaches upload queue/response handling with the oversized virtual path.
Matching PlaceInQueueRequest performs queued_users lookup and emits PlaceInQueueResponse echoing the oversized path.
FolderContentsRequest handler emits FolderContentsResponse with the oversized requested directory and token even when no folder data exists.
Transfer-control parsers preserve a 4098-component path without component-count rejection.
